text: Created troubleshooting agent skill at .claude/skills/troubleshooting.md — covers 3-service Railway architecture, OTLP→New Relic observability pipeline, 12 common failure modes with diagnostic paths and runbook cross-references, Railway-specific diagnostics, env var verification, and integration with the existing BUG-FIX-PROTOCOL. Registered as an invocable skill.

Switched OTLP telemetry destination from New Relic to Honeycomb. Changed header format from `Authorization=Basic {key}` to `x-honeycomb-team={key}` in both apps/api and apps/worker TelemetryBootstrapExtensions.cs. Railway env vars still use Telemetry__Otlp__Endpoint and Telemetry__Otlp__ApiKey — just values change to Honeycomb's endpoint (https://api.honeycomb.io) and Ingest API key.

Fixed perpetual WebSocket reconnect cycle: PushAlertProvider.tsx and UserLayout.tsx both called getLiveAlerts().start() on the singleton, causing the second start()'s closeWs() to kill the first connection. The killed connection's onclose fired scheduleReconnect(10s), which killed the real connection 10s later, creating an infinite ~10.8s cycle. Confirmed via HAR (2 entries 11.3s apart, both 101) and Honeycomb (116 connections/2h, P50=10,861ms, all status 101). Fix: removed redundant client.start() from UserLayout.tsx line 57.

Updated all documentation files to replace New Relic references with Honeycomb after the observability vendor migration. Changed files: .claude/skills/troubleshooting.md (full rewrite of observability sections), docs/deployment-phase1-zero-cost.md (entire Step 3, env vars, cost table, diagram), docs/adr/0002-observability-and-configuration.md (historical note), infra/README.md (example URLs), docs/deployment_plan.md (example endpoint), docs/rough_notes.txt (deprecated NR entries). Source code was already using Honeycomb headers (x-honeycomb-team) — only docs needed updating. Created FACT.md with observability setup reference.

Added web app telemetry (logging + tracing + metrics proxy). Architecture: browser → POST /api/v1/telemetry/events → API Serilog → OTLP → Honeycomb. Created telemetry client at apps/web/src/lib/telemetry.ts (batched, auth-gated), proxy endpoint at apps/api/TelemetryProxy/, instrumented apiFetch with timing + correlation IDs, added web vitals (LCP/CLS/INP/FCP), global error tracking, and SPA page view tracking.

Added OpenTelemetry integration for SignalStack.Web (Next.js 16). Created instrumentation.ts (Next.js hook) and src/instrumentation/otel.ts (OTel setup). Server-side logs/traces/metrics now ship directly to Honeycomb via OTLP/HTTP Protobuf using the same Telemetry__Otlp__* env vars as API/Worker. Added 13 @opentelemetry/* packages.

Removed API telemetry proxy dependency. Created Next.js route POST /api/telemetry/events that logs browser events via OTel LoggerProvider. Updated browser TelemetryClient to ship events to same-origin endpoint instead of API proxy. Deleted API TelemetryProxyEndpoints.cs, WebTelemetryModels.cs, and removed them from Program.cs. Browser telemetry now lands in SignalStack.Web dataset.

Completed comprehensive OTel instrumentation across all 3 services. API: Added ActivitySource, Npgsql telemetry, auth/execution instrumentation with business-context tags and metrics, request metrics middleware, user enrichment on spans. Worker: Added per-job tracing to all 7 jobs (DataSync, EODSR, HDS, LADS, LMDS, NDJ, FyersTokenCheck), expanded meters, startup activity enrichment, error span events across catch blocks. Web: Created ErrorBoundary, error.tsx, global-error.tsx, server-logger utility, replaced ad-hoc console.* calls with telemetry/serverLogger, added traceparent propagation, custom span on telemetry ingestion endpoint.

Fixed web app instrumentation crash: Removed serverExternalPackages from next.config.ts — Turbopack was creating hashed symlinks (.next/node_modules/@opentelemetry/api-<hash>) for OTel packages that broke in Docker multi-stage builds. Also fixed corrupted local @opentelemetry/api package via npm install.

Fixed chart page crash: lightweight-charts createChart() was passing CSS var() expressions (--fg-2, --bg-2, --line-1, --up-500, --down-500) which the library's internal color parser can't resolve. Created cssVar() helper in apps/web/src/lib/css-vars.ts that reads computed CSS variable values via getComputedStyle at runtime, and updated the chart page to use resolved hex values instead of raw var() strings.

Fixed "Refresh" button errors on dashboard: root cause was BsonNull.AsString crash in BuildSyncStatus (ReconciliationEndpoints.cs:255) when sync_status field missing from fyers_account_sync doc after refresh upsert. Also fixed frontend handleRefresh error handling (missing error state on refresh failure, missing error clear on success) and loadData error clear. Backend fix: checked IsBsonNull before AsString. Frontend fix: setError on non-ok refresh responses, setError(null) on success.

Fixed RAILWAY_COMMIT_SHA → RAILWAY_GIT_COMMIT_SHA across all 4 telemetry/version files. Railway's actual env var name is RAILWAY_GIT_COMMIT_SHA (with GIT_ in it) per docs.railway.com/variables/reference

Renamed telemetry resource attribute `git.commit.sha` → `build_id` across all 3 services (API, Worker, Web otel.ts). Added `generateBuildId` to next.config.ts returning `RAILWAY_GIT_COMMIT_SHA` so `_next/static/<buildId>/` paths change per deploy, busting all browser caches. Also renamed version API response key from `commitSha` to `buildId` and updated the frontend LegalFooter component to match.

Fixed case-sensitivity bug in AdminSystemHealthEndpoints.cs — Filter.Eq("status", "Active") with PascalCase "Active" didn't match MongoDB documents storing lowercase "active" via FyersTokenStatus.Active constant. Changed to use the constant. Commit f74e775 pushed to origin/main.

Fixed JobRunDocument deserialization crash — DataSyncWorker writes session_date_range_start/session_date_range_end/session_count as raw BsonDocument fields, but AdminHomeEndpoints reads job_runs as typed JobRunDocument which lacked those properties. Added [BsonIgnoreExtraElements] to the class. Commit bcc6102 pushed to origin/main.

Extracted BsonNull-safe BSON field accessors into shared BsonExtensions class in SignalStack.Storage. Added GetBsonStringOrNull, GetBsonDocumentOrNull, GetBsonDateTimeOrNull, GetBsonInt32OrNull as extension methods on BsonDocument (fixes InvalidCastException when BsonNull.Value is accessed with .AsString/.AsBsonDocument/.AsInt32 — the ?. operator does not short-circuit on BsonNull because it's not C# null). Applied across 14 source files in apps/api and apps/worker (AdminIncidentEndpoints, AdminSystemHealthEndpoints, AdminHomeEndpoints, AdminPositionEndpoints, AdminLegalPostureEndpoints, PortfolioEndpoints, UniverseSyncEndpoints, TimeStopRecomputeService, SharedTokenHealthService, EodMarkerReader, DataSyncWorker, EodSignalRunnerWorker, LiveMarketScanService).
